items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

extra.description: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策知识库,形成一种更高效、灵活的应变机制。首先,以基于长尾变化特征的提示词工程为媒介,使前端业务人员能够通过自然语言与大语言模型进行交互并获得应变方案。其次,结合后端管理层制定的业务基线目标约束对应变方案进行功能性约束验证,提出的SSDT-Lane算法基于流程结构相似性对应变方案进行筛选,消除了大语言模型在流程调整、业务和组织架构匹配等方面面临的幻觉风险。基于合成数据和真实开源数据集的典型案例分析实验显示,LLM-Adapt相比现有方法,在应变准确性、效率、适用性等方面都表现出显著优势。

items.title: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.title_zh: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.summary_zh: 战术对抗仿真实验是作战分析、模拟训练和基于仿真的装备活动的核心手段,其智能化、自动化水平直接影响实验效能和战斗力的生成。针对传统仿真实验存在的实验设计、模型构建、导调控制和人机交互效率低等问题,参考MCP协议提出大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的体系架构。该架构包含基础层、工具资源层、AI Agent层、赋能层、应用层,这5层架构自顶向下牵引,自底向上逐层整合,可实现大小模型与数据资源和传统小模型的耦合聚合,并赋能基于仿真的各项军事活动。在此基础上,重点研究讨论了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的具体路径:大模型赋能仿真实验设计,大模型赋能决策模型构建,大模型赋能导调控制。最后,分析了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验面临的挑战,并给出了相应的应对措施。

extra.description: 战术对抗仿真实验是作战分析、模拟训练和基于仿真的装备活动的核心手段,其智能化、自动化水平直接影响实验效能和战斗力的生成。针对传统仿真实验存在的实验设计、模型构建、导调控制和人机交互效率低等问题,参考MCP协议提出大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的体系架构。该架构包含基础层、工具资源层、AI Agent层、赋能层、应用层,这5层架构自顶向下牵引,自底向上逐层整合,可实现大小模型与数据资源和传统小模型的耦合聚合,并赋能基于仿真的各项军事活动。在此基础上,重点研究讨论了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的具体路径:大模型赋能仿真实验设计,大模型赋能决策模型构建,大模型赋能导调控制。最后,分析了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验面临的挑战,并给出了相应的应对措施。

items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 基于归因的单细胞基础模型诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA基础模型（scFM）越来越多地用于计算机生物发现，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示其决策依赖的是具有生物学意义的信号还是模型特定的捷径。我们系统研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控设置中使用scGPT+STATE进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因评估预测是否依赖已确立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达排名和周围细胞上下文变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成设置中将归因模式与已知调控真值比较，以评估它们对模型学习计算的揭示。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征使用、上下文交互、不同输入通路的贡献、学习进展、与预测质量的关联，以及标准性能指标未完全捕捉的潜在陷阱。使用完整和有限调控知识的实验进一步表明，从归因得出的结论强烈依赖于生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。总之，这些发现凸显了归因作为灵活事后诊断的价值

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: Rethinking One Gene, One Token: Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 重新思考一基因一标记：面向单细胞基础模型的转录组感知标记化
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基础模型通常将每个基因视为一个标记，这既昂贵又浪费。一个细胞可以表达数千个基因，因此每个基因一个标记使自注意力计算代价高昂，然而其中许多基因以低水平检测到，携带的信号太少，不值得拥有自己的标记。一起表达的基因可以共享一个标记，而为突出的基因保留单独的标记。我们介绍scTAT（转录组感知标记化），它将基因集词汇表与逐细胞分词器配对。该词汇表包含在预训练语料中具有稳定相对表达的重叠基因集。使用这些集合带来两个困难。第一，哪些基因应共享一个标记取决于细胞，而现有多基因标记预先固定分组。第二，不同大小的基因集必须与单基因在共同尺度上比较。因此分词器逐细胞决定，让基因集和单基因在按集合大小平方根归一化的表达分数下竞争标记位置。训练仍然重建单个基因，因此预测保持在基因分辨率。在冻结嵌入细胞类型注释中，scTAT以一半的标记预算匹配最强的一基因一标记模型。在相同预算下，其相对于一基因一标记模型的优

extra.description: Single-cell foundation models typically treat each gene as a token, which is both costly and wasteful. A cell can express thousands of genes, so one token per gene makes self-attention expensive, yet many of these genes are detected at low levels and carry too little signal to deserve a token of their own. Genes that are expressed together could instead share a token, leaving separate tokens for genes that stand out. We introduce scTAT (Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization), which pairs a gene-set vocabulary with a per-cell tokenizer. The vocabulary holds overlapping gene sets that recur with stable relative expression across the pretraining corpus. Using these sets raises two difficulties. First, which genes should share a token depends on the cell, whereas existing multi-gene tokens fix the grouping in advance. Second, gene sets of different sizes must be compared with single genes on a common scale. The tokenizer therefore decides per cell, letting gene sets and single genes compete for token positions under an expression score normalized by the square root of set size. Training still reconstructs individual genes, so predictions stay at gene resolution. In frozen-embedding cell-type annotation, scTAT matches the strongest one-gene-per-token model with half the token budget. Its advantage over one-gene-per-token models at the same budget grows as the budget shrinks and the tokenizer assigns more positions to gene sets. Encoding the same genes with gene-set tokens also nearly halves the Transformer's matrix-multiplication cost. These results show that a token need not hold exactly one gene: when the tokenizer decides per cell which genes share a token, a fixed budget covers more of each transcriptome at no cost in annotation accuracy.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 处理不平衡QSAR回归的比较策略：hERG活性预测案例研究
items.summary_zh: 数据不平衡在QSAR建模中经常出现，但大多数研究集中于分类任务，很少涉及回归任务，因为确定数据的稀疏或密集区域具有挑战性。数据级和算法级的不平衡处理策略可能对模型性能产生不同影响。在本研究中，我们系统比较了GCN和基于指纹的机器学习模型中的各种策略。为更有意义地评估模型性能，我们基于领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为若干子区域。我们重点关注最具实际意义的区域。结果表明，基于该关注区域指标选择模型比使用总区域指标能带来更可靠的性能。我们还观察到，不同不平衡处理策略的效果因模型类型而异。这些发现凸显了回归QSAR建模中区域感知评估的重要性，并为不平衡数据集选择适当策略提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹与RNA动力学：ManifoldVelo
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和RNA速率，需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，尤其是在复杂周期和分支分化中。在此我们介绍ManifoldVelo，一个拓扑条件框架，联合学习细胞坐标、连续RNA轨迹和调控动力学。未剪接和剪接RNA轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括在观测细胞之间，使表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互 informing。ManifoldVelo在所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型中恢复伪时间，包括循环、多分支和光滑非分支轨迹。ManifoldVelo在多峰循环模拟中在所比较方法中实现最佳伪时间恢复，并在多峰循环和分支模拟中实现剪接RNA速率最高方向一致性。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的相位预测，以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势在于在可复用的动态参考中联合恢复不同轨迹结构中的时间位置和局部动力学。新细胞仅从剪接RNA即可获得伪时间和速率预测，无需重新拟

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
items.title_zh: 论智能体式操作策略
items.summary_zh: 近期机器人操作研究主要集中于在演示数据上训练的专家策略。我们表明，通用 AI 模型能够比视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）等专家策略更可靠地控制机械臂。我们系统分析了智能体式操作策略（AMP），其中通用 AI 模型直接指挥机械臂，并随任务展开调整其动作。我们提出 AMP1，一个参考框架，可在单臂、双臂和移动操作中不加修改地运行。AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 和 CaP-Gym 基准上取得最先进结果，无需演示或任务特定训练。在 RoboLab-120 上，AMP1 零样本达到 85.6% 的成功率，而领先的 VLA 和 WAM 策略分别为 49.2% 和 42.9%。该智能体在涵盖十二个任务和三个机器人实例的 108 次真实世界试验中零样本成功 104 次，相对于强 VLA 和 WAM 基线将失败率降低了 20 倍和 15 倍。基础框架不提供抓取、推动或放置技能

extra.description: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6\% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2\% and 42.9\% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.

items.title: On the Reliability of Majority-Vote Pseudo-Labels in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 论测试时强化学习中多数投票伪标签的可靠性
items.summary_zh: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）使用自生成伪标签将预训练语言模型适配到无标签目标域数据，其可靠性仍知之甚少。我们分析了在线直接偏好优化（DPO）下 TTRL 的多数投票监督，并将其误差分解为群体多数偏差和提示依赖的有限 rollout 变异。由于群体多数偏差在没有外部监督的情况下通常不可识别，我们专注于减轻有限 rollout 变异的下游影响。我们提出提示条件分布鲁棒 DPO（PC-Dr.DPO），它将提示内鲁棒重加权以观察到的投票可靠性为条件，使来自采样敏感提示的更新更加保守。我们进一步引入基于缓存的机制以减少在线适配过程中的自监督遗忘。在六个数学和知识密集型推理基准以及五个模型骨干上，PC-Dr.DPO 在 30 个设置中的 24 个中达到或超过最强的 TTRL 基线。

extra.description: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts pretrained language models to unlabeled target-domain data using self-generated pseudo-labels, whose reliability remains poorly understood. We analyze majority-vote supervision for TTRL with online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and decompose its error into population-majority bias and prompt-dependent finite-rollout variation. Because population-majority bias is generally unidentifiable without external supervision, we focus on mitigating the downstream effects of finite-rollout variation. We propose \emph{Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO (PC-Dr.DPO)}, which conditions within-prompt robust reweighting on observed vote reliability to make updates from sampling-sensitive prompts more conservative. We further introduce a cache-based mechanism to reduce self-supervised forgetting during online adaptation. Across six mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks and five model backbones, PC-Dr.DPO matches or outperforms the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings.

items.title: GRAC: Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning for Surgical Scene Description
items.title_zh: GRAC：基于图的检索增强描述生成用于手术场景描述
items.summary_zh: 目的：手术操作报告支持程序记录、手术培训、性能评估和工作流程审查。然而，提取有意义的信息通常需要大量人工审查和临床专业知识。自动化手术场景描述可以通过利用反复出现的手术活动和先验知识来减轻这一负担。方法：我们提出 GRAC（基于图的检索增强描述生成），一个将手术场景表示为图以捕捉器械、动作和解剖结构之间关系的框架。给定输入场景图，GRAC 学习从训练数据中检索相关的图-描述对。它比较检索示例与输入场景之间的器械-组织交互，使用比较特征在生成过程中调节检索描述的表示。结果：在 EndoVis-18 基准上，GRAC 达到 CIDEr-D 5.88，而 SGT 为 4.23，最强的传统 Transformer 基线为 3.36。精确器械-动作-目标三元组集合准确率达到 52.6%，而 SGT 为 32.7%，最强的传统基线为 26.2%。这些结果证明了语言质量和事实一致性的提升。在 TORS

extra.description: Purpose: Surgical operative reports support procedural documentation, surgical training, performance assessment, and workflow review. However, extracting meaningful information often requires extensive manual review and clinical expertise. Automated surgical scene descriptions could reduce this burden by leveraging recurring surgical activities and prior knowledge. Methods: We propose GRAC (Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning), a framework that represents surgical scenes as graphs capturing relationships among instruments, actions, and anatomical structures. Given an input scene graph, GRAC learns to retrieve relevant graph-caption pairs from training data. It compares instrument-tissue interactions between retrieved examples and the input scene, using comparison features to condition retrieved-caption representations during generation. Results: On the EndoVis-18 benchmark, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.88, compared with 4.23 for SGT and 3.36 for the strongest conventional Transformer baseline. Exact instrument-action-target triplet-set accuracy reached 52.6%, compared with 32.7% for SGT and 26.2% for the strongest conventional baseline. These results demonstrate improvements in language quality and factual agreement. On TORS, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.06, compared with 3.80 for the strongest baseline. Conclusion: GRAC demonstrates that combining structured surgical scene representations with retrieved examples improves surgical scene captioning and produces more contextually meaningful descriptions.

items.title: Flow-Guided Target-Space Alignment via Path Consistency
items.title_zh: 通过路径一致性实现流引导的目标空间对齐
items.summary_zh: 许多多模态对齐问题需要将源模态映射到由目标模态定义的固定空间，其中目标空间不仅是中间嵌入，而是直接用于下游分析。在此设置下，成功的对齐应同时保留目标分布的全局结构和配对源–目标训练数据中观察到的实例级对应关系。现有目标通常只解决部分目标：对比损失鼓励相对相似性，分布匹配损失改善边缘一致性，逐点回归将每个源样本拟合到其配对目标而不显式建模目标空间路径几何。我们提出 FlowAlign，一种流引导的目标空间对齐方法，它将条件流匹配重新用作训练时对齐信号而非推理时传输模型。FlowAlign 使用学习到的流场引导源侧表示与固定目标空间的对齐，鼓励它们保留配对对应关系同时保持与全局目标空间结构的兼容性。我们进一步提供理论分析，展示 FlowAlign 如何通过控制端点准确性和捕捉局部目标空间几何来帮助改善配对对应关系。在合成数据、配对单细胞多组学基准和图像–文本对齐上的实验表明，FlowAlign

extra.description: Many multimodal alignment problems require mapping a source modality into a fixed space defined by a target modality, where the target space is not merely an intermediate embedding but is used directly for downstream analysis. In this setting, successful alignment should preserve both the global structure of the target distribution and the instance-level correspondence observed in paired source--target training data. Existing objectives typically address only part of this goal: contrastive losses encourage relative similarity, distribution-matching losses improve marginal agreement, and pointwise regression fits each source sample to its paired target without explicitly modeling target-space path geometry. We propose FlowAlign, a flow-guided target-space alignment method that repurposes conditional flow matching as a training-time alignment signal rather than an inference-time transport model. FlowAlign uses the learned flow field to guide the alignment of source-side representations with the fixed target space, encouraging them to preserve paired correspondence while remaining compatible with the global target-space structure. We further provide theoretical analysis showing how FlowAlign helps improve paired correspondence by controlling endpoint accuracy and capturing local target-space geometry. Experiments on synthetic data, paired single-cell multiome benchmarks, and image--text alignment demonstrate that FlowAlign improves instance level correspondence while preserving target-space structure across different modality settings.

items.title: Fifty-Two Shades of Pig: What the UCR Archive Really Asks Classifiers to Do
items.title_zh: 猪的五十二种色调：UCR 档案真正要求分类器做什么
items.summary_zh: 猪在流血。这正是实验的目的：气道压力能否在出血变得危急之前揭示它？在 UCR 时间序列分类档案——时间序列分类（TSC）事实上的基准——中，同样的记录提出了不同的问题：“这 52 头猪中哪一头产生了这条轨迹？”。数据集 PigAirwayPressure 并非异常值。尽管该档案是标准基准，但其任务是否类似于 TSC 旨在解决的问题却很少被审视。我们发现若干数据集是从其原始任务重新利用的、由玩具设置构建的，或具有有缺陷的测试划分。我们进一步质疑档案中有序非时间序列（如光谱、形状轮廓）对真实 TSC 的代表性，以及多变量问题分解的潜在弊端。我们的发现呼吁更谨慎地解读档案范围的分数，并更加关注与部署相关的评估。审计见 https://github.com/automl/ucr-provenance-audit。

extra.description: The pigs were bleeding. That was the point of the experiment: could airway pressure reveal hemorrhage before it became critical? In the UCR Time Series Classification Archive, the de facto benchmark for Time Series Classification (TSC), the same recordings ask a different question: "which of 52 pigs produced this trace?". The dataset PigAirwayPressure is not an outlier. Although the archive is the standard benchmark, whether its tasks resemble the problems TSC is meant to solve has rarely been examined. We find that several datasets are repurposed from their original task, built from toy setups, or have flawed test splits. We further question how representative the archive's ordered non-temporal sequences (e.g. spectra, shape outlines) are of real TSC, and the potential downsides from the decomposition of multivariate problems. Our findings call for more careful interpretation of archive-wide scores and greater attention to deployment-relevant evaluation. The audit is at https://github.com/automl/ucr-provenance-audit.

items.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
items.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法-系统协同设计的原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码
items.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存在长上下文 LLM 服务中主导内存容量和带宽。虽然 4 位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）缩小了缓存并在 FP4 Tensor Core 上运行注意力，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在根本差距：现有 FP4 KV 系统使用朴素量化导致严重精度下降，而面向精度的 4 位算法依赖向量码本，其查找开销降低了解码吞吐量。我们提出 BitDecoding-FP4，一种用于准确高效原生 FP4 KV 解码的算法–系统协同设计。我们缓解三个误差来源：双残差查询量化将查询拆分为两个 FP4 张量，将查询 logit 误差从 60% 降至 1%；下溢感知概率缩放防止 E4M3 缩放将长上下文概率舍入为零；离群值感知键量化结合静态平滑、Hadamard 旋转和缩放搜索以在逐 token 缩放下抑制键离群值。在系统层面，我们通过转置 softmax 配合融合概率量化和在分页 KV 缓存上的

extra.description: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.

items.title: Scalable methylome-transcriptome profiling resolves clonal organization in human hematopoiesis
items.title_zh: 可扩展的甲基化组-转录组分析解析人类造血中的克隆组织
items.summary_zh: 理解人体组织维持和重塑需要将克隆祖先与分子状态联系起来，然而可扩展的联合测量仍然具有挑战性。在此我们介绍 Droplet-MT 及一个集成计算工作流，用于每文库约 10,000 个细胞的联合转录组和甲基化组分析。甲基化表观突变使得能够从高覆盖甲基化组进行不依赖突变的克隆重建，而基于参考的标签转移以约 0.2% CpG 覆盖度将细胞分配给已建立的克隆，降低测序成本。克隆聚合的体细胞变异提供遗传注释而无需额外的单细胞基因分型。在来自健康血液和纵向急性髓系白血病的约 21,000 个配对图谱中，我们解析了具有异质性谱系输出的小克隆和扩增克隆。在白血病中，该框架区分了恶性克隆丰度的变化、持续克隆内的状态重塑以及健康多克隆造血的恢复。恶性单核细胞尽管经历治疗相关重塑，在转录和表观遗传上仍与健康和恢复相关细胞不同。Droplet-MT 通过将克隆组织与分子状态及回顾性遗传注释联系起来，实现了人体组织的

extra.description: Understanding human tissue maintenance and remodeling requires linking clonal ancestry to molecular state, yet scalable joint measurement remains challenging. Here, we introduce Droplet-MT and an integrated computational workflow for joint transcriptome and methylome profiling at ~10,000 cells per library. Methylation epimutations enable mutation-independent clonal reconstruction from high-coverage methylomes, while reference-based label transfer assigns cells to established clones at ~0.2% CpG coverage, reducing sequencing cost. Clone-aggregated somatic variants provide genetic annotation without additional single-cell genotyping. Across ~21,000 paired profiles from healthy blood and longitudinal acute myeloid leukemia, we resolved small and expanded clones with heterogeneous lineage output. In leukemia, the framework distinguished changes in malignant clonal abundance, state remodeling within persistent clones, and recovery of healthy polyclonal hematopoiesis. Malignant monocytes remained transcriptionally and epigenetically distinct from healthy and recovery-associated cells despite treatment-associated remodeling. Droplet-MT enables scalable analysis of human tissues by linking clonal organization with molecular state and retrospective genetic annotation.

items.title: Clinical-Anchored Incremental Survival Learning: A Stability-Constrained Framework for Molecularly Enhanced Survival Prediction in Lung Adenocarcinoma
items.title_zh: 临床锚定的增量生存学习：一种用于肺腺癌分子增强生存预测的稳定性约束框架
items.summary_zh: 肺腺癌（LUAD）的准确生存预测仍然具有挑战性，因为高维分子数据可能引入过拟合和不稳定的特征选择。我们开发了临床锚定的增量生存学习（CAISL），一个将稀疏分子风险校正与临床基线整合的框架，以提高预后判别力同时约束模型复杂性和预测变异性。CAISL 使用包含 470 名患者和 119 例观察死亡的癌症基因组图谱 LUAD 队列进行评估。使用五次独立种子、事件分层五折交叉验证运行，与临床 Cox、仅分子和无锚定多模态模型进行比较。CAISL 达到平均一致性指数（C-index）0.7246，而临床 Cox 为 0.6970，绝对改善 0.0276（95% bootstrap 置信区间 [CI]，0.005 至 0.050）。时间依赖判别力在三年时更高（AUC，0.742 vs. 0.712），五年时更高（AUC，0.721 vs. 0.691），而 CAISL 的积分 Brier 分数低于临

extra.description: Accurate survival prediction in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains challenging because high-dimensional molecular data can introduce overfitting and unstable feature selection. We developed Clinical-Anchored Incremental Survival Learning (CAISL), a framework that integrates a sparse molecular risk correction with a clinical baseline to improve prognostic discrimination while constraining model complexity and prediction variability. CAISL was evaluated using The Cancer Genome Atlas LUAD cohort comprising 470 patients and 119 observed deaths. Performance was compared with clinical Cox, molecular-only, and unanchored multimodal models using five independently seeded, event-stratified five-fold cross-validation runs. CAISL achieved a mean concordance index (C-index) of 0.7246, compared with 0.6970 for clinical Cox, yielding an absolute improvement of 0.0276 (95% bootstrap confidence interval [CI], 0.005 to 0.050). Time-dependent discrimination was higher at three years (AUC, 0.742 vs. 0.712) and five years (AUC, 0.721 vs. 0.691), while the integrated Brier score was lower for CAISL than for clinical Cox (0.164 vs. 0.181). Ablation analysis identified clinical anchoring as the component associated with the largest reduction in discrimination when removed. Stability analysis showed a mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of 0.46 between selected feature sets and a mean Spearman correlation of 0.86 between molecular correction scores. These findings support the potential of clinically anchored, stability-constrained molecular learning to improve internal survival-risk prediction in LUAD. Independent-cohort validation is needed to establish generalizability.

items.title: Gene regulatory architecture in antibiotic resistance is optimized for specific dynamic regimens
items.title_zh: 抗生素耐药性的基因调控架构针对特定动态方案进行优化
items.summary_zh: 细胞对抗生素的响应面临一个基本权衡：耐药性必须部署得足够快以防止药物在细胞内积累，但耐药基因的表达在无药物时是有代价的。因此，抗生素响应通常受到调控，不仅控制耐药性是否表达，还控制何时、多强以及持续多久。这些调控策略通过启动子和操纵子的强度和排列来实现。然而，药物暴露的动态如何选择特定调控策略仍不清楚。在此我们开发了一个典型抗生素响应的动力学模型，其中转录阻遏物感知药物并调控耐药蛋白的表达，与药物对细胞生长和基因表达的影响耦合。我们定义了一个成本函数，权衡响应过程中施加于细胞的不同负担，并针对三种复杂度递增的架构在不同选择压力下进行调控参数的计算机优化：耐药性的组成型表达、由组成型表达的阻遏物抑制、以及由自调控阻遏物抑制。我们发现强药物暴露有利于耐药性的组成型表达，基础表达的高成本有利于组成型阻遏物的抑制，而阻遏物的自调控仅在响应必须提供保护同时抑制耐药性过表达时受到青睐。随机模拟进一步表

extra.description: Cellular responses to antibiotics face a fundamental trade-off: resistance must be deployed quickly enough to prevent the accumulation of drug inside the cell, but expression of resistance genes is costly in the absence of the drug. Therefore, antibiotic responses are typically regulated, controlling not only whether resistance is expressed, but also when, how strongly, and for how long. These regulatory strategies are implemented through the strength and arrangement of promoters and operators. However, it is still not clear how the dynamics of drug exposure select for specific regulatory strategies. Here, we develop a dynamical model of a typical antibiotic response, where a transcriptional repressor senses the drug and regulates expression of a resistance protein, coupled to the effects of the drug on cell growth and gene expression. We define a cost function that weighs the different burdens imposed on the cell over the course of the response, and perform in silico optimization of the regulatory parameters under different selective pressures for three architectures of increasing complexity: constitutive expression of resistance, repression by a constitutively expressed repressor, and repression by a self-regulated repressor. We find that strong drug exposures favor constitutive expression of resistance, high costs of basal expression favor repression by a constitutive repressor, and self-regulation of the repressor is favored only when the response must provide protection while also restraining overexpression of resistance. Stochastic simulations further show that self-regulation of the repressor protects cells against fluctuations in repressor levels, which cause unnecessary induction of resistance before exposure and failed induction after exposure. This framework links the dynamics of the environment to the evolution of gene regulation, providing a basis to predict which regulatory strategies are expected to arise under specific selective pressures.

items.summary_zh: 北京时间11月9日，英伟达CEO黄仁勋近日向公司员工发出一封道歉信，承认自己对妻子不忠，并就此向家人、公司员工、董事会及股东公开道歉。 黄仁勋在信中表示，自己的行为伤害了妻子和孩子，没有任何借口。他愿意承担全部责任，并希望能够逐渐重新赢得家人和同事的信任。 以下为黄仁勋道歉信全文： 致英伟达的各位同事： 我欠我的家人，以及你们所有人一个道歉。 我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。对于我所做的一切，没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。 一直以来，我的家人给予了我爱与支持。他们本应得到我的诚实与忠诚，但我却辜负了他们，也破坏了我们共同建立的生活。我愿意为自己的所作所为及造成的伤害承担全部责任，并接受因此受到的批评。 致我的妻子和家人：我爱你们。我知道，一句道歉无法弥补我所犯下的错误。我希望我们的家庭能够慢慢走出伤痛，也希望随着时间推移，我能够重新赢得你们的信任。 致英伟达的各位同事，包括那些与我

items.title_zh: 大连文体旅集团旗下景区对山东老铁免费 100 天，以贺大连英博中超夺冠，你怎么看？能把大连文旅带火吗？
items.summary_zh: 大连文体旅集团：旗下景区对山东老铁免费100天！“从此11月8日·忆·山东兄弟” 11月8日晚，大连文体旅集团官方宣布，大连文体旅集团旗下景区对山东游客免费开放100天：2026年11月8日至2027年2月16日，山东游客(身份证住址为山东省)凭本人身份证，可免费游览以下景区:大连老虎滩海洋公园国有部分(包含入园、珊瑚馆、鸟语林)、大连森林动物园、白玉山景区、东鸡冠山景区、黄渤海分界线景区、军港游园。 11月8日下午，随着主裁判吹响比赛结束的哨声，大连英博3:1战胜天津津门虎成功夺得2026赛季中超联赛冠军，大连足球再度书写历史。而山东泰山3:2战胜成都蓉城。至此，大连足球在中国足坛顶级职业联赛的冠军总数累计达到9座，正式超越广州的8座冠军奖杯，独居全国顶级足球联赛冠军城市榜首。 https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1881305056992421595

items.title_zh: 马斯克爆料称「软银正在违约燃气轮机订单」，是真的吗？这一爆料对市场的影响有多大？
items.summary_zh: 财联社11月8日讯 当AI基建浪潮本周深陷"中期选举焦虑"之际，一则来自马斯克的惊人指控，在周五又将孙正义与软银集团推向了风口浪尖。 美东时间周五，特斯拉及SpaceX首席执行官马斯克在社交平台X上抛出重磅言论："软银正在违约其燃气轮机订单。" 马斯克当时是在回复X用户Katie Miller时作出这一表态的。Miller的帖子转发了媒体消息称，荷兰国际集团(ING)正计划一次性出售总额约5亿美元的数据中心贷款组合。 值得玩味的是，马斯克在发布这条爆炸性推文时，并未出示任何能够佐证软银"违约"的内部凭证或供应商声明。截至发稿，软银方面未就该指控做出公开回应，相关主要燃气轮机制造商亦保持沉默。 但将视线拉回产业基本面，软银当下确实手握极其庞大的算力扩张图纸。 公开资料显示，软银在俄亥俄州规划的超大型数据中心基建，配套包含了高达9.2吉瓦(GW)的新建天然气发电装机容量。早在今年5月，软银旗下

items.title: 微信状态发「画地为牢」被公司辞退，理由是「工作不积极」，社交吐槽能成为公司解除劳动关系的理由吗？
items.title_zh: 微信状态发「画地为牢」被公司辞退，理由是「工作不积极」，社交吐槽能成为公司解除劳动关系的理由吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，一名网友发微信状态自嘲“画地为牢”，配的是周一上班的状态。 结果周一当天，公司以“工作态度不积极”为由，把他辞退了。荔枝新闻中心深潜工作室记者与该网友取得联系后确认，他已离职并获得相应赔偿。 在一些年轻人看来，这句话中的“画地为牢”符合自己工作时长期待在工位、机械呆板的状态，将其引申成了对于上班的自我调侃。 在网友看来，公司显然没把这句话当成玩笑。 问题来了——在朋友圈、微信状态这种半公开的场景中吐槽，是否可以成为公司解除劳动关系的理由？ 微信状态发“画地为牢”后被公司辞退，理由竟是“工作不积极”！律师：企业此举缺乏法律依据

items.title_zh: 如何看待大连英博问鼎本赛季中超冠军，但无一人入选新一期国足名单？客观来看这份名单选得如何？
items.summary_zh: 雷速体育11月8日讯 中超收官战，大连英博3-1击败天津津门虎，奇迹般获得本赛季中超冠军。不过，在最新一期公布的中国国家队大名单中，并没有冠军之师大连英博球员的身影。 在邵佳一最新一期的国足大名单中，大连英博没有球员入选，而最终排名第二的成都蓉城有5名球员，是本期入选国家队球员最多的俱乐部。本期国足大名单俱乐部分布如下 上海海港足球俱乐部：颜骏凌、蒋光太、吾米提江·玉苏普、杨希 上海申花足球俱乐部：吴曦、蒋圣龙 成都蓉城足球俱乐部：韩鹏飞、杨明洋、王子铭、胡荷韬、拜合拉木·阿卜杜外力 北京国安足球俱乐部：张玉宁、林良铭、塞尔吉尼奥 山东泰山足球俱乐部：刘洋、谢文能 天津津门虎足球俱乐部：巴顿、黄嘉辉、闫炳良 浙江职业足球俱乐部：刘浩帆、王钰栋 云南玉昆足球俱乐部：布尼亚明·阿不都沙拉木 青岛西海岸足球俱乐部：李昊 河南足球俱乐部：王上源 广东广州豹足球俱乐部：黄晟豪 英格兰伍尔弗汉普顿流浪

items.title: 英伟达突发「史上最大GPU盗窃案」，价值 1140 万美元的硬件失踪，具体什么情况？可能带来哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 英伟达突发「史上最大GPU盗窃案」，价值 1140 万美元的硬件失踪，具体什么情况？可能带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 近日，美国加利福尼亚州奥克兰发生一起精心策划的货运劫案，一批价值高达1140万美元（约合7610万元人民币）的英伟达硬件在运往得克萨斯的途中失踪。 正在调查该案件的奥克兰警方表示，整批货物共六托盘英伟达硬件，8月29日启运，目的地为得州沃斯堡。提货环节一切正常，货物被登记为一家食品运输公司的货车提走。 调查人员追踪发现，卡车曾在途中多次停靠，单次停留时长达数小时，最终在加州东南部圣贝纳迪诺县失去踪迹。 奥克兰警方在声明中称：“奥克兰警察局正在调查东奥克兰发生的这起重大盗窃案，受害方于2026年9月13日报案。” 该案件是已知单笔案值最高的NVIDIA单车货运失窃案，多家媒体将本次事件描述为“史上最大GPU盗窃案”。分析人士表示，这可能是一起针对高科技企业精心策划的盗窃案。 近年来，美国频发高价值科技货品盗窃案。去年，加州弗里蒙特市与联合市警方就调查过多起针对英伟达货物的入室盗窃，涉案金额逾

items.title: 上海微电子新一代光刻机模型亮相，该成果实现量产还需要攻克哪些核心难点？
items.title_zh: 上海微电子新一代光刻机模型亮相，该成果实现量产还需要攻克哪些核心难点？
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，第九届中国国际进口博览会于 11 月 5 日在国家会展中心（上海）开幕。 本次展会上，上海微电子装备（集团）股份有限公司（简称 SMEE）携自主研发的新一代前道干式光刻机通用技术平台模型正式亮相，展示我国前道光刻装备自主化的阶段性成果。 据介绍，SMEE 成立于 2002 年，是国内唯一具备前道干式光刻机稳定量产交付能力的制造商，也是我国前道光刻装备自主供给体系的核心支撑主体。 本次展出的模型采用透明剖视设计，直观呈现整机光学光路与内部机电系统的链路布局。该平台为国产标准化前道光刻装备架构，适配 I-line、KrF 两类主流技术路线，整机核心的高精度物镜与照明系统、高速双工件台与掩模台、一体化自动物料传输系统、高精度对准调平传感系统均实现全链条自主可控，具备稳定的工艺适配能力与产线运行可靠性。 IT之家获悉，目前国产前道干式光刻机成像性能已与国际同类领先产

items.title: 自媒体曝胖东来爆火的卡蓓诺洗发水疑为非日本制造，胖东来否认产地造假并将启动维权，哪些信息值得关注？
items.title_zh: 自媒体曝胖东来爆火的卡蓓诺洗发水疑为非日本制造，胖东来否认产地造假并将启动维权，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 今天（8日），胖东来商贸集团发布《关于“卡蓓诺洗发水”相关不实信息的说明》，全文如下： 2026年11月7日，网络平台出现“胖东来销售卡蓓诺洗发水产地造假”的相关视频，对此公司高度重视。 此类不实信息在2026年1月已经出现，我们当即成立专项调查小组，对事件进行了全面调查，全部调查材料已提交司法机关，并对此事件提起诉讼。现将核实情况说明如下： 一、关于商品的产地和来源 2026年1月，我们赴卡蓓诺中国贸易商“广州市平辰贸易有限公司”进行现场调查，同月赴日本科思美碧优蒂总部，对研发中心、生产车间实地溯源，逐项查验企业资质、报关单、入境货物检验检疫证明、原产地证明及批次检验记录、特殊化妆品注册证、进货查验和产品销售记录等，并将上述票据、证件与进口资料逐项追溯核对，同时留存影像及书面材料备查。核查结果确认：该产品原产地为日本，未发现视频所称在国内生产、冒充进口的情形。 二、关于案件的进展 对视频

items.title: 5吨的大象都会被吃，骆驼却几乎无天敌，为啥没有食肉动物吃它呢？
items.title_zh: 5吨的大象都会被吃，骆驼却几乎无天敌，为啥没有食肉动物吃它呢？
items.summary_zh: 动物世界里有个挺反差的事。五吨重的大象，偶尔还会被狮群盯上，可骆驼，明明没那么夸张的块头，却在野外几乎没天敌。很多食肉动物，看见它都得绕道。这事儿，得从骆驼自己身上找原因。
